# Several suppliers offer 2/10 net 30. I cannot pay them all early. Which do I pay?

> Free tool for small businesses with several 2/10 net 30 style supplier discounts and not enough cash to take them all: get the exact set of invoices to pay early after your cost of cash, compared with highest-rate-first and other rules. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
